news.headline: Infosys shares jump 3% ahead of Q2 earnings announcement. What to expect?
news.summary: Infosys shares rose on Friday ahead of the IT major’s Q2 FY27 results, with analysts expecting an 11% year-on-year rise in revenue and an 8% increase in net profit. Investors will track management commentary on client spending, large deal wins and AI-led pricing pressure, alongside the company’s full-year revenue growth guidance.

news.headline: Global Market: Eurozone bond markets stabilise after volatile week
news.summary: Eurozone government bonds stabilised after a volatile week as investors balanced sovereign debt concerns against safe-haven demand amid uncertainty over AI investments and global growth. French borrowing costs remain under pressure ahead of key central bank policy decisions.

news.headline: Adani Power Q2 Results: Profit zooms 134% YoY to Rs 6,919 crore; revenue jumps 45%
news.summary: Adani Power has reported an impressive consolidated net profit of Rs 6,919 crore for the second quarter of FY27, which marks a striking 134% increase from last year's profit of Rs 2,953 crore during the same period. Additionally, their operational revenue surged to Rs 19,439 crore, representing a 45% growth from Rs 13,457 crore the previous year.

news.headline: Sterlite Technologies Q2 Results: Profit surges 12,817% YoY to Rs 517 crore, revenue jumps 145%
news.summary: Sterlite Technologies reported a 12,817% year-on-year jump in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 517 crore, while revenue surged 145% to a record Rs 2,529 crore. Strong demand for AI-ready digital infrastructure, improved margins and a one-time tariff refund gain supported performance, as its open order book reached Rs 35,274 crore.

news.headline: Q2 Results Live Updates: Adani Power Q2 profit soars 134% YoY to Rs 6,919 crore, revenue rises 45% YoY
Safe-haven demand pushes Japan’s 10-year yield to two-month low
news.summary: Japanese government bonds saw a rally on Friday, leading to the benchmark 10-year yield hitting a two-month low. This surge occurred in response to a global selloff in tech stocks, prompting investors to flock to safer investment options. The approaching Bank of Japan policy meeting is the center of attention as market watchers analyze the implications for inflation and possible interest rate shifts.

news.headline: Infinx plans $300 million IPO in India, appoints three bankers
news.summary: Infinx Technology Solutions has appointed Kotak Mahindra Capital, Nomura and Avendus to manage its proposed $300 million IPO, targeting FY28. Backed by KKR and Norwest Venture Partners, the healthcare IT firm provides AI-powered revenue cycle management services and has expanded through strategic investments and acquisitions, including i3 Verticals’ healthcare business.

news.headline: Rs 9,000 crore wiped out in a day: Why Swiggy investors are losing patience with Instamart
news.summary: Swiggy shares plunged on Friday, wiping out around ₹9,000 crore in market value as widening Instamart losses overshadowed food delivery growth. Following Q2 results, brokerages cut their price targets, citing deteriorating quick-commerce profitability. Instamart’s adjusted EBITDA loss widened to ₹895 crore from ₹778 crore, while its contribution margin deteriorated to -1.4% despite 13.4% sequential growth in net order value.

news.headline: Jio IPO Day 3: GMP at 22%, issue subscribed over 5X; check brokerage views and key details
news.summary: Jio Platforms’ ₹30,213 crore IPO entered its final day of bidding on October 23, with a grey market premium of around 22%, indicating positive listing sentiment. The issue was subscribed 5.57 times by the end of Day 2, while the retail portion was subscribed 1.54 times. Priced at ₹1,065–1,119 per share, the IPO values Jio at around ₹10.3 lakh crore at the upper end. Brokerages remain optimistic, citing its telecom leadership, improving profitability and growth opportunities in broadband and AI.

news.headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 results preview: PAT may rise up to 32% YoY; margins, loan growth in focus
news.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank is likely to report significant year-on-year growth in net profit for Q2FY27. Brokerages estimate profit after tax to rise between 27% and 31.9%, driven by strong net interest income growth. Loan and deposit growth will remain key factors influencing the bank's overall performance and profitability. Investors will closely monitor net interest margins and operating expenses for signs of sustainability.

news.headline: HDFC Bank Share Price Live Updates: HDFC Bank's Latest Price Update
D-Street bleeds! Market value of all BSE-listed firms falls below Rs 450 lakh crore for first time since April. More pain ahead?
news.summary: The market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies fell below Rs 450 lakh crore for the first time since April as Sensex and Nifty extended losses for a fourth straight session. Nearly Rs 25 lakh crore has been wiped out this week, with soaring crude prices and rising bond yields weighing on sentiment.

news.headline: Global Market: Bank Indonesia defends policy mix after market confusion
news.summary: Bank Indonesia has defended its latest policy package combining an unchanged benchmark rate, a higher deposit facility rate and reserve requirement cuts. The central bank says the measures aim to improve monetary policy transmission, boost banking liquidity and support credit growth.

news.headline: Nasdaq CEO flags IPO slowdown amid market volatility
news.summary: The IPO market is grappling with hurdles stemming from macroeconomic instability and fluctuating market conditions that are influencing corporate strategies. Numerous firms have either delayed or abandoned their public listing intentions lately. Nevertheless, Nasdaq maintains a sturdy and vibrant pipeline for future listings, even as analysts caution that a revival in IPO activity likely won't materialize until 2026 without a surge in investor interest.

news.headline: Cyient shares rally 9% after Q2 revenue rises 25%; board declares Rs 12/sh interim dividend
news.summary: Cyient shares surged on Friday after the company reported a 25% year-on-year rise in consolidated revenue to Rs 2,235 crore in Q2 FY27. Net profit declined 8% to Rs 132 crore. The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share, while its DET business reported stronger revenue and order intake.
